title: fix(components,app-shell,plugin-gantt,plugin-calendar): four more date faces read the display locale, not the UI language (objectui#10442)
body:
Fixes #10442
Clause-②: no

Four date faces now take their locale from `useDisplayLocale()` instead of the UI language. Implemented by a dispatched dev subagent under seat `domain:ui#5` (session `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`), cut from `111fa4c94` and merged up to `origin/main` `fee1da595` before this PR opened.

## Premise, re-derived on `111fa4c94`

The dispatch read `6881e9e`. All four sites were on the base as the card quotes them:

- `data-table.tsx`, in `formatCellValue`: `formatDateTime(value, { locale: language })` and `formatDate(value, undefined, { locale: language })`, with `language` from `useTableTranslation()`.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx`, in the History effect: `const fmtCtx = { t, locale: language, lookupLabels };`. `formatScalar` in `auditHistoryDisplay.ts` spends `ctx.locale` on `toLocaleDateString` / `toLocaleString`.
- `ResourceWorkload.tsx`: `const locale = language || undefined;`.
- `CalendarView.tsx`: `const effectiveLocale = locale !== "default" ? locale : language`, where the `locale` prop defaults to `"default"`.

## What changed

- Each component calls `useDisplayLocale()` in its body and passes that tag where `language` went. No fallback is added. The hook owns the last resort.
- `data-table`: `language` had no other use, so it is no longer destructured. The `useCallback` dependency is `displayLocale`. The two comments that said the cells format with the i18n language now name the display locale.
- `RecordDetailView`: `fmtCtx.locale` is `displayLocale`. `language` stays, because the action-param resolution still uses it to pick a per-locale LABEL map (out of scope per the card). The History effect's dependency list gains `displayLocale`.
- `auditHistoryDisplay.ts`: only the `AuditValueFormatContext.locale` doc comment changes. It now says a React caller passes `useDisplayLocale()`.
- `ResourceWorkload`: `locale` is `useDisplayLocale()`, and `columnLabel` takes a `string`. An empty language no longer falls through to the machine locale.
- `CalendarView`: only the `"default"` branch changes. An explicit `locale` prop is a host's choice and still wins.
- Changeset `10442-date-faces-display-locale.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` and `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`.

## Mechanism readings (the dispatch's H1 to H3)

- **H1**: confirmed on `111fa4c94`. The four sites are the ones quoted above.
- **H2**: confirmed. The calendar pin has an explicit-prop case: `locale: 'fr-FR'` under a `de-CH` display locale renders French. It stays green on both legs of the reverse verification, as a must-not-change pin should.
- **H3**: confirmed. All four packages already declare `@object-ui/i18n` in `dependencies`, and `@object-ui/test-support` in `devDependencies`. No `package.json` changes, so there is no new dependency edge.

## Tests

Four new pin files, one per face. Each mounts the real `I18nProvider` with an ENGLISH UI and declares the display locale through `LocalizationProvider`. Each has a `de-CH` case, an `en-US` control, and a "reading of the session, not of the machine" pin that compares the two raw readings. The three faces that render synchronously also run the `recordLocaleArguments` tripwire from `@object-ui/test-support`: no locale-taking call may receive the machine locale or `'en'`.

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-display-locale-10442.test.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.auditDisplayLocale-10442.test.tsx`: the synthesized record page, opened on its History tab through the `tab` URL param. The diff line is read off the rendered timeline.
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ResourceWorkload.displayLocale-10442.test.tsx`
- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.displayLocale-10442.test.tsx`

### Reverse verification

Run after the fix and the pins were committed, under a trap restore. The five source files were checked out from `111fa4c94`. On-disk proof before the run: `grep -c useDisplayLocale` answered 0 in each file, and each defect line counted back at 1 or more. Then the four pins ran, and the files were restored from `HEAD`. Restore proof: `git hash-object` equals the `HEAD` blob for each file, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- Fixed tree: 4 files, 16 passed.
- Base sources: 4 files failed, 11 failed and 5 passed. The five that stay green are the four `en-US` controls and the calendar's explicit-prop case.

### Gates

The pins and the targeted suites ran on `c6cca3b` (the tree before the changeset commit), and again on the merged head `5aeb4e7`. Every exit below was read from the gate's own verdict line, captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/`, the `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table` files, `displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`, `packages/plugin-gantt/`, `packages/plugin-calendar/`, the `auditHistoryDisplay` tests and `machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`: exit 0 on both heads. On `5aeb4e7`: 154 files passed, 2 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/`, in chunks (the full directory runs past the container's foreground cap): on `c6cca3b`, 498 files passed over four chunks (142, 151, 100, 105). On `5aeb4e7`, the chunk that holds `RecordDetailView` and its neighbours was re-run: 143 files passed. The chunks were checked to add up to the directory's full list.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --concurrency=2` for the four packages: 33 of 33 tasks on `c6cca3b`, and again on `5aeb4e7`. Each package script runs `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` too, and that config includes the new test files.
- eslint, plain, on the 9 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors. `pnpm lint` is CI's; this narrowing is a measurement because: (1) eslint's own `isPathIgnored` reports all 9 files as linted; (2) the `--format json` output counts 9 files, 0 errors; (3) `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (no type-aware linting), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's result.
- Exit 0 on `5aeb4e7`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (9 source files of 4 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:i18n-keys`.
- `check:unused-deps` was not run: no dependency changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two more faces of the same class, left for the seat to file** (outside this card's four and outside the claimed file surface):
  - `GanttView.tsx` (`plugin-gantt`) still does `const dateLocale = language || undefined;` for the timeline header, the task-list dates, the period label and the drag tooltips. `ObjectGantt`'s tooltips already read `useDisplayLocale()`, so one gantt now shows two locales.
  - `ObjectCalendar.tsx` (`plugin-calendar`): the quick-create dialog formats `quickCreate.start` with the component's `locale` prop, which is undefined whenever no host passes one, so it uses the machine locale. The census is blind to it because the argument is an expression.
- **Comments this change leaves stale, outside the claimed file surface and not edited:** the `resolveAuthoredLocale` doc comment in `calendar-view-renderer.tsx` says `CalendarView` falls back to the ambient i18n language. The `createSafeTranslation` comment in `useSafeTranslation.ts` names data-table and gantt as consumers that localize dates with `language`. The `useGanttTranslation.ts` comment says `language` is threaded into the date formatters (still true for `GanttView`).
- eslint warnings on added lines: 4. Three are `no-explicit-any` in the new tests, the sibling tests' `as any` idiom for a schema and a data source. One is the `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warning on data-table's `useCallback` dependency line, whose missing `ISO_DATE_RE` predates this change.
- The first three commits carry a model-named `Co-Authored-By` trailer, written from a harness attribution note, where the model-free pair is the rule. History is not rewritten. The later commits carry the model-free pair.
